m1.typescript: m1 a well made tool lints clean and a poor one is named for every rule it breaks

e1.typescript: e1 names must match the pattern and a vague name is flagged

e2.typescript: e2 a description needs three sentences a when to use phrase and a boundary against the neighbour

e3.typescript: e3 parameters are described and required names exist and closed sets are enums and examples fit the schema

e4.typescript: e4 a list tool needs a limit and a cursor and a hint may not contradict the name

e5.typescript: e5 a set is graded for duplicate names overlapping descriptions and size

e6.typescript: e6 pages carry an opaque cursor and a clamped limit and a note

e7.typescript: e7 a page stops at the size cap and says so but always carries one item

e8.typescript: e8 a tools own hints are trusted only from a trusted server and the defaults apply otherwise

wrong-name-spaces-allowed.defect: accepts a name with spaces, dots or a hash sign

wrong-vague-case-sensitive.defect: flags a vague name only when it is written in lower case

wrong-two-sentences-ok.defect: accepts a description of two sentences

wrong-boundary-do-not-only.defect: accepts only the words do not use as a boundary against a neighbouring tool

wrong-required-unchecked.defect: does not notice a required name that is not a property

wrong-example-enum-ignored.defect: accepts an example whose value is outside the enum

wrong-bool-is-integer.defect: accepts true as an integer example

wrong-undescribed-ok.defect: does not notice a parameter without a description

wrong-limit-only.defect: asks a list tool for a limit but not for a cursor

wrong-hint-readonly-only.defect: checks the read-only hint against the name but not the destructive hint

wrong-duplicate-allowed.defect: lets two tools share a name

wrong-overlap-strict.defect: does not flag descriptions that overlap by exactly the threshold

wrong-count-off-by-one.defect: flags a set that is exactly as large as the budget

wrong-limit-unclamped.defect: lets the limit grow beyond the maximum page size

wrong-no-note.defect: leaves out the note that tells the model how to continue

wrong-cursor-unchecked.defect: starts from the beginning when the cursor is not valid

wrong-cap-exclusive.defect: stops one item early when a page fills the size cap exactly

wrong-truncated-never.defect: never reports that a page was cut by the size cap

wrong-untrusted-honoured.defect: reads the hints of a server that is not trusted

wrong-parallel-untrusted.defect: lets a tool of an untrusted server run in parallel on its own say so
